Mo Elleithee is the former spokesman for the Democratic National Committee, and Doug Heye is a former spokesman for the Republican National Committee.

items.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
items.summary: Even for countries where typhoons are a way of life, the last few months have brought unusually wild weather.

items.title: Democrats take Congress in a blue wave. Here's what it means for your money
items.summary: Blue wave gives Democrats control of Congress. Here's how their agenda could affect your money, from healthcare and taxes to student loans and Social Security.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV welcomes Bob Dylan to the Vatican in a brief visit
items.summary: Leo gave Dylan a rosary, while Dylan presented the pope with a copy of his autobiography, "Chronicles: Volume One."

items.title: Democrats take House and Senate from Republicans in US midterm rout
items.summary: Democrats will control both chambers of Congress after flipping seats in Republican strongholds across the US in an election seen as a repudiation of President Donald Trump.

items.title: Figma sinks after earnings beat as company prioritizes long-term growth with AI changes
items.summary: Figma is letting clients use more artificial intelligence features for the same price. The company would like the move to boost results in the long term.
